actc.earned_floor.heading: Schedule 8812 (2025)
actc.earned_floor.quote: Is the amount on line 18a more than $2,500?

actc.rate.heading: Schedule 8812 (2025)
actc.rate.quote: Multiply the amount on line 19 by 15% (0.15)

actc.three_children.heading: Schedule 8812 (2025)
actc.three_children.quote: On line 16b, is the amount $5,100 or more?

dc.limit_one.heading: Form 2441 (2025)
dc.limit_one.quote: Don’t enter more than $3,000 if you had one qualifying person or $6,000 if you had two or more persons.

dc.limit_two.heading: Form 2441 (2025)
dc.limit_two.quote: Enter $3,000 ($6,000 if two or more qualifying persons)

dc.persons_two.heading: Form 2441 (2025)
dc.persons_two.quote: Enter $3,000 ($6,000 if two or more qualifying persons)

dc.child_age.heading: Qualifying Person(s)
dc.child_age.quote: A qualifying child under age 13 whom you can claim as a dependent. If the child turned 13 during the year, the child is a qualifying person for the part of the year they were under age 13

f5329.simple_rate.heading: Line 4
f5329.simple_rate.quote: you must multiply that amount by 25% instead of 10%.

f5329.excess_rate.heading: Part VII
f5329.excess_rate.quote: Additional tax. Enter 6% (0.06) of the smaller of line 48 or the value of your HSAs on December 31, 2026

f5329.cap_first_home.heading: First home
f5329.cap_first_home.quote: you don't have to pay the 10% additional tax on up to $10,000 of distributions you receive to buy, build, or rebuild a first home.

f5329.cap_emergency.heading: Emergency personal expense distributions
f5329.cap_emergency.quote: must not exceed the lesser of $1,000 or your total interest in the IRA minus $1,000.

edu.magi_limit.heading: Part I
edu.magi_limit.quote: Enter $180,000 if married filing jointly; or $90,000 if single, head of household,

edu.phaseout_range.heading: Part I
edu.phaseout_range.quote: Enter $20,000 if married filing jointly; or $10,000 if single, head of household,

aoc.full_band.heading: Part III
aoc.full_band.quote: Subtract $2,000 from line 27. If zero or less, enter -0-

aoc.refundable_rate.heading: Part I
aoc.refundable_rate.quote: Refundable American opportunity credit. Multiply line 7 by 40% (0.40).

llc.expense_cap.heading: Part II
llc.expense_cap.quote: Enter the smaller of line 10 or $10,000

ptc.twelfth.heading: line 8b
ptc.twelfth.quote: Monthly contribution amount. Divide line 8a by 12. Round to nearest whole dollar amount

hsa.additional_rate.heading: Form 8889 (2025)
hsa.additional_rate.quote: Enter 20% (0.20) of the distributions included on line 16 that are subject to the additional 20% tax

hsa.no_months.heading: Line 3
hsa.no_months.quote: You are treated as having the same HDHP coverage for the entire year as you had on the first day of the last month of your tax year

hsa.half.heading: Line 6
hsa.half.quote: divide the amount on line 5 equally between you and your spouse

sc.one.heading: Line A
sc.one.quote: complete a separate Schedule C for each business

sc.meals_rate.heading: Line 24b
sc.meals_rate.quote: In most cases, you can deduct only 50% of your business meal expenses

sc.meals_rate_dot.heading: Line 24b
sc.meals_rate_dot.quote: for individuals subject to the Department of Transportation (DOT) hours of service limits, the percentage is increased to 80%

sc.ho_max_sqft.heading: Simplified Method Worksheet
sc.ho_max_sqft.quote: Don't enter more than 300 square feet

savers.cap.heading: Form 8880 (2025)
savers.cap.quote: In each column, enter the smaller of line 5 or $2,000
